name: Veniczar S. Arcadius
source: Veniczar S. Arcadius is the mysterious leader of PACT, intent on dominating every human being in the galaxy. He/she was the leader of The PACT Revolution since it's mid stages, so theoretically he/she should be in it's sixties. Despite this, due to his/her young looks and short stature he/she appears young. Combining this with his/her mask and the fact that he/she always speaks through a computer, a lot of people suspect that he/she were different people, and that the name of Arcadius may have passed through a lot of leaders to make the illusion of an immortal leader. This precisely, immortality, seems to be the obsession of he/she, or at least the current Arcadius.
